name: Magellan Corporation
note: US distributor of specialty steels (office listed in Deerfield, Illinois); the Fire's Official Jersey Sleeve Sponsor since 2024. Its website names the leadership (President Bob Arthur, President since its inception in 1985, per e-magellan.com/team) but does not state who owns the company, and no public filing or press report naming an owner was found, so no ownership claim could be written and the sponsor stays not rated yet.
